name: Duet Night Abyss
description: Element-driven ARPG roster — 28 characters, skill data and Mystic Maze rankings for most.

tierNotes.title: Immersive Theatre
tierNotes.body: Theater doesn't reduce to a fixed ranking — each stage favors a specific element, and the strongest pick is whichever roster covers that element. Umbro-favored stages, for example, lean on Flora or the Umbro-aligned Phoxhunter. A static tier list would misrepresent how this mode actually works.

tierNotes.title: Farming tiers by level bracket
tierNotes.body: No public source currently splits the meta into sub-Lv.100 vs Lv.100+ farming tiers for this game — rankings are benchmarked at max investment across the board. This section will fill in if that changes.
